title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - Agent
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/Agent. An agent making an action in the context of a city; an agent could be a person, software, organization, etc. Subclass of foaf:Agent (http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Agent), restricted so that cpsv:provides and cpsv:uses can only point to s4city:PublicService instances. A s4city:PublicAdministration (which is itself a subclass of org:Organization, not of Agent) is typically also typed as an Agent in instance data when it needs to provide or use public services, per the normative ETSI TS 103 410-4 worked example.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Agent'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

provides.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.org/vocab/cpsv#provides'. The PublicService entities this agent provides, directly or by outsourcing; the Agent that provides the service is the one ultimately responsible for its provision.

uses.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.org/vocab/cpsv#uses'. The PublicService entities this agent uses, playing the role of user (providing the input and receiving the output without a direct role in providing the service) -- typically an individual citizen or an outside organisation.
